stage0007b_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$さやか$$
「《$$映画『ソレスタルビーイング』$$》...」

stage0007b_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「More destructive power than I expected...」

stage0007b_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong, everyone?
　Didn't you enjoy the movie based on you?」

stage0007b_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Celestial Being and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, fighting the
　$$アロウズ$$ who became evil's pawns...
　What a thrilling action blockbuster.」

stage0007b_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, it's not a documentary,
　so of course the actors exaggerate some, but...」

stage0007b_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$甲児$$
「Amazing...
　The Gundam Meisters turned into a hero,
　a nerd, a cutie, and a power fighter...」

stage0007b_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ボス$$
「And on top of it, the $$ダブルオーライザー$$
　was a full-on Super Robot.」

stage0007b_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$甲児$$
「Mazinger being a 200-meter-tall
　giant of light did move me a little.
　Even if it was treated as a mob, though...」

stage0007b_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's still better off.
　Since all the robots were guys in suits,
　the VF-25 only had its Battroid mode...!」

stage0007b_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Who'd have thought the fight with
　the $$アロウズ$$ would become a good-vs-evil hero flick.」

stage0007b_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh... Guess those involved aren't satisfied.」

stage0007b_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But to fully erase the old Earth Federation's
　bad image from being controlled by the $$アロウズ$$,
　maybe a simple story like this is needed too.」

stage0007b_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$アルト$$
「I understand that much myself.
　But the fighting 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》 did
　wasn't anything like that.」

stage0007b_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's right.
　Besides, there were way more members than that...」

stage0007b_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm fine...
　Just had a bit of a headache...」

stage0007b_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$アルト$$
「Me too...
　Maybe it's the theater air getting to me.」

stage0007b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$さやか$$
「Everyone but us was so excited.」

stage0007b_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「True...
　I wonder if that group over there saw the movie too.」

stage0007b_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「The 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》 Gundam's amazing too!
　The Gundam myth crosses parallel worlds!」

stage0007b_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ミコット$$
「You're way too excited, $$タクヤ$$.」

stage0007b_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「How could anyone not get excited!
　I'm gonna become an Anaheim test pilot for sure
　and ride a new-model Gundam!」

stage0007b_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「No real man could watch that and not get fired up!
　Right, $$沙慈$$?」

stage0007b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$沙慈$$
（I can't tell them...
　that I was a $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ member too...）

stage0007b_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$沙慈$$
（Though I didn't appear in that movie...）

stage0007b_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ミコット$$
「You're gloomy too, $$バナージ$$.
　It's our day off, so let's enjoy it more.」

stage0007b_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Then smile.
　It's a fun, thrilling entertainment movie.」

stage0007b_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Maybe you're just not used to gravity yet?
　It's only been about a month since you got to Earth.」

stage0007b_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$沙慈$$!
　It is you, $$沙慈$$!」

stage0007b_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Hey, $$甲児$$.
　I saw Mazinger the other day,
　so I figured we'd meet again someday.」

stage0007b_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That's $$沙慈・クロスロード$$.
　We fought together in 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》.」

stage0007b_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$n
「Will you invite him to the Academy Defense Force too?」

stage0007b_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「No, not likely.
　$$沙慈$$ just got swept up in things
　and ended up fighting almost by accident.」

stage0007b_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Besides, more than anything,
　he's chasing his own dream now.」

stage0007b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$甲児$$
「So why are you here, anyway?
　How's $$ルイス$$ doing?
　Still studying aerospace engineering?」

stage0007b_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$沙慈$$
「I'll answer in order.
　After the $$再世戦争$$, I went back
　to 《$$アッシュフォード学園$$》...」

stage0007b_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$沙慈$$
「After that, I transferred to Anaheim's
　technical college for hands-on training.」

stage0007b_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$さやか$$
「Anaheim... you mean
　the one tied to Anaheim Electronics?」

stage0007b_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$沙慈$$
「That's right.
　The main campus is in space, but I'm at
　the branch here in $$第２新東京市$$.」

stage0007b_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アルト$$
「So you're studying in the same city as us.」

stage0007b_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$沙慈$$
「I came out here today
　to visit $$ルイス$$ in the hospital.」

stage0007b_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$沙慈$$
「$$ルイス$$ is in a hospital downtown.」

stage0007b_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$さやか$$
「Is she still... not doing well?」

stage0007b_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$沙慈$$
「She's gotten a lot better.
　But she still gets headaches sometimes.」

stage0007b_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「...These folks friends of yours, $$沙慈$$?」

stage0007b_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Friends from before I came to Anaheim.」

stage0007b_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Let me introduce you to $$甲児$$ and the others.
　They're my classmates at Anaheim...
　Though I'm older than the rest of them.」

stage0007b_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「I'm $$タクヤ・イレイ$$.
　Nice to meet you.」

stage0007b_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ミコット$$
「I'm $$ミコット・バーチ$$.
　I'm at Anaheim Tech too, with $$沙慈$$.」

stage0007b_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

stage0007b_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「You're so stiff, $$バナージ$$.
　You nervous or something?」

stage0007b_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$沙慈$$
「$$バナージ$$ and the others came from the
　colony Industrial 7 to $$第２新東京市$$ on a
　short exchange. Natural gravity's new to them.」

stage0007b_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ミコット$$
「But I like $$第２新東京市$$.
　It's pretty, and there are lots of people our age.」

stage0007b_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You're students at Anaheim Tech, right?
　You could've just joined today's
　hiking trip, you know.」

stage0007b_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「At our age, hiking's kind of a hard sell...」

stage0007b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ミコット$$
「So after coming along to visit $$沙慈$$,
　we decided to go see a movie, just us.」

stage0007b_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「We're... heading to 《$$ふもふもランド$$》 after this.
　Want to come along, if you're free?」

stage0007b_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's an amusement park at the edge of
　$$第２新東京市$$. Its mascot $$ボン太くん#robot$$'s
　apparently having a quiet boom right now.」

stage0007b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Isn't that even more childish than hiking?」

stage0007b_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「But I hear it's a popular date spot too.」

stage0007b_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$アルト$$
「What was that sound just now!?」

stage0007b_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$さやか$$
「A news bulletin just came in!
　Looks like terrorists have shown up again!」

stage0007b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Tch... Seems our excuse to skip hiking
　turned into a real incident.」

stage0007b_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「What do we do, she says...!
　We just gotta run, obviously!」

stage0007b_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$沙慈$$!
　We'll go check the situation!
　You get your friends and run!」

stage0007b_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Got it!
　You guys be careful too!」

stage0007b_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0007b_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0007b_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0007b_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0007b_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$オットー$$
「Welcome to the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.
　I'm her captain, Colonel $$オットー・ミタス$$.」

stage0007b_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'm Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$, captain of
　the Macross Quarter. This is Major
　$$オズマ・リー$$, the strike force leader.」

stage0007b_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Now, let me introduce another staff member.
　This is our XO, Lt. Colonel $$レイアム・ボーリンネア$$.」

stage0007b_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$オットー$$
「And this is Echoes' $$ダグザ・マックール$$, Lt. Colonel,
　and his adjutant, Major $$コンロイ・ハーゲンセン$$.」

stage0007b_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$オズマ$$
（So this is the Echoes, the so-called
　Man $$ハンター$$...）

stage0007b_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Pleased to meet you, Colonel $$ジェフリー$$.
　I've heard the rumors about the Frontier
　fleet's $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ myself.」

stage0007b_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I've heard of Echoes' exploits as well.
　And with you both aboard, I think I understand
　this ship's mission well enough now.」

stage0007b_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Man $$ハンター$$...
　So you already knew of our primary mission...」

stage0007b_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$オットー$$
「Then this will go quickly.
　As you guessed, Colonel, Londo Bell's main duty
　lately is investigating Neo Zeon's suspicious moves.」

stage0007b_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$オットー$$
「Under the command of Colonel $$ブライト・ノア$$,
　our ships operate both on Earth and in space.」

stage0007b_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And you're here to investigate
　operations within the atmosphere?」

stage0007b_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「That's correct.
　We were recently tracking a mobile suit unit
　that appeared to be Neo Zeon, descending to Earth.」

stage0007b_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Sagara, you snuck off from the hike...
　where on earth did you go?」

stage0007b_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「And Kabuto, Saotome, $$ミシェル$$,
　$$ボス$$, $$ヌケ$$, $$ムチャ$$, $$さやか$$!
　And you, $l...」

stage0007b_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Skipping out on a hike everyone
　was supposed to join, what's the deal?」

stage0007b_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$甲児$$
「T-there's a good reason for this...
　Right, $$アルト$$?」

stage0007b_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「And another thing, $l!
　Since you weren't there, Sagara went
　completely out of control!」

stage0007b_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He put on some weird camo outfit
　and went sprinting all over the place,
　then started setting traps everywhere...」

stage0007b_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What should've been a fun outing
　turned into an obstacle course in no time!」

stage0007b_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　I was only trying to secure everyone's safety.」

stage0007b_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's why you're the biggest danger here!」

stage0007b_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's enough, Chidori.
　Everyone just transferred in, so they were
　exploring $$第２新東京市$$ to get used to the city.」

stage0007b_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If that's what it was, you should've said so.
　I could've shown them around.」

stage0007b_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Right!
　They didn't want to trouble you, since you
　were so fired up about the hike...」

stage0007b_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Well, fine.
　Miss $$スズネ$$ was with you this time,
　so it's not really my place to say anything.」

stage0007b_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But if you pull something like this again,
　I've got some ideas of my own about it!
　Got it, Sagara!?」

stage0007b_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Heh... Sagara's surprisingly good at
　balancing school life with his $$ミスリル$$ work.）

stage0007b_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「...Today was rough, wasn't it, $$沙慈$$?」

stage0007b_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Yeah.
　But I'm glad everyone's safe.」

stage0007b_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ミコット$$
「I... kind of see $$沙慈$$ in a new light now.
　Staying calm and level-headed even at
　a time like that, that's impressive.」

stage0007b_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$沙慈$$
「I'm just a little older than everyone else.
　That much was nothing...」

stage0007b_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$沙慈$$
（$$甲児$$ and $$アルト$$ are fighting for peace...
　I have to work hard too, so I don't lose to them...）

stage0007b_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「But I never thought I'd see the newest
　TMS, the $$リゼル$$, in actual combat.」

stage0007b_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Word is it's still in field trials.」

stage0007b_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$沙慈$$
「You really know your stuff, $$タクヤ$$.」

stage0007b_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Of course I do.
　My dream's to become a test pilot or
　mechanic at Anaheim someday.」

stage0007b_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ミコット$$
「$$バナージ$$, are you tired?」

stage0007b_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$バナージ$$
（That strange feeling I had while evacuating...
　What in the world was that...）

stage0007b_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$バナージ$$
（It was like someone was calling out to me...）

stage0007b_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...My, my, Master $$カミーユ$$...
　that sortie was quite the ordeal, wasn't it?」

stage0007b_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$...
　$$ルカ$$ told me about you, but you're quite the robot.」

stage0007b_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, no, no... I'm nothing special,
　just a Z-chip miser with profit on the brain.」

stage0007b_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, that pilot $$ギュネイ$$'s rivalry with
　you, Master $$カミーユ$$, it made for fine Z-chips.」

stage0007b_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Worth a whopping 100 Z!
　I'll just add that to the stock.」

stage0007b_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So that's how Z-chips are generated...」

stage0007b_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But please be careful.
　That man is sure to come after you again,
　Master $$カミーユ$$, given the chance.」

stage0007b_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Thanks.
　But I don't plan on going down easily either.」

stage0007b_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's the spirit.
　I'll be looking forward to more
　wonderful Z-chips from you.」

stage0007b_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh my, Miss $$スズネ$$... nice work
　on your first sortie.」

stage0007b_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What seems to be the matter?
　You look awfully upset, was $n's
　attitude bad again, perhaps?」

stage0007b_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Mr. $$ＡＧ$$!
　What is with that outfit!?」

stage0007b_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The battle suit from when I boarded the $$ジェニオン$$!」

stage0007b_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, that one.
　That outfit is a manifestation of the
　pilot's own inner heart.」

stage0007b_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes.
　So because $n wished to grow stronger,
　the style turned out combat-oriented.」

stage0007b_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, whatever the style,
　a protective skin and exoskeleton
　keep the pilot perfectly safe.」

stage0007b_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, we're also holding onto
　your glasses temporarily.」

stage0007b_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We warp the space in front of your eyes
　to serve as a lens, so it shouldn't
　cause any trouble.」

stage0007b_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The human heart, well,
　it's a bit odd for me to say so myself,
　but it truly is a complicated thing...」

stage0007b_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even a lady who seems pure on the surface
　might, underneath, be a bundle of desire...
　a blood-hungry beast, in some cases.」

stage0007b_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So then, Miss $$スズネ$$,
　just what kind of suit did you end up with?」

stage0007b_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「N-no... it's nothing.
　I-I was just... a little startled, that's all...」

stage0007b_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is that so.
　Well then, please continue to favor
　$$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation going forward.」

stage0007b_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's get to it, business, business!」
